chapter: Family, Margaret's story and Eutris's memories
title: Margaret recalls meeting Jay C. in Charleston in 1924
summary: Mrs. H recalls meeting him in Charleston, West Virginia, with Horace Henderson in 1924, and gives his path through Cincinnati and Buffalo.

story.theme_name: Meeting, marrying and raising a family
story.community_name: Meeting, courting and marrying: musicians' love lives

blocks.x: Just about what you were telling me before, about the first time you met Jay C.
That was back in 1924. He came to Charleston with Horace Henderson.
Charleston, West Virginia?
Charleston, West Virginia, the capitol of West Virginia, which I hope someday to go back and live. Love it!
Horace Henderson.
You said he came to Charleston with Do you remember what year that was?
A couple things I'd like to get straight. He was at Atlanta at Morris Brown and played around at little towns and stuff like that.
No, first time he went to Cincinnati to live with his sister and that's when she got him that horn. She was the one that bought him the horn, because it's in his biography.
She bought it in Cincinnati?
Yes.
And that's where he was at?
Yes, he was living with her. He's in pain; he can't remember all that.
Could you tell me - he was born in -
In Social Circle.
In Social Circle. Then they moved to Decatur?
Well, I don't know if they moved there. You know, he was in Atlanta going to school and his brother lived in Atlanta.
But he said something about Decatur/
Well, I guess he visited there because he's got friends there. But when he left Atlanta he went to Cincinnati.
Now do you know when he left Atlanta?
Do I know when? I don't know that, but I know he was 18 years old when he came to Charleston, playing professionally.
In 1924. There was something about Buffalo.

Then he went to Buffalo. They sent for him, because a fellow was here one night and he told me they sent for him. If you want to see that picture - he thought he was sharp. He had on a hat too big for him. They sent for him to come to Buffalo. I forget the man's name, but he had pictures of him. He was the youngest one in the band, in Buffalo. Then he came to New York and then he went with Fletcher.
He went from Horace? To Fletcher Henderson's band also. So that would put it around 1925.
Something like that, maybe later. I wouldn't know exactly. Then Chick Webb heard him and then he went to Louis. Get that album back there... What year was you with Fletcher? It's all back there.
Everything is in the book and the book weighs as much as you do.

Do you know why we're doing interviews like this? So many of us have found that all of the information, a lot of the information that we have in books is wrong. The only way to get it straight is to do this type of interview.
